questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to go to another place?
explanation: Travel is the correct spelling - T-R-A-V-E-L. To travel means to make a journey to another place.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to make clear?
explanation: Explain is the correct spelling - E-X-P-L-A-I-N. To explain means to make something clear or easy to understand.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to gather together?
explanation: Collect is the correct spelling - C-O-L-L-E-C-T. To collect means to gather things together. It has double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to get ready?
explanation: Prepare is the correct spelling - P-R-E-P-A-R-E. To prepare means to make ready for something in advance.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to find something new?
explanation: Discover is the correct spelling - D-I-S-C-O-V-E-R. To discover means to find something new for the first time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to put in order?
explanation: Arrange is the correct spelling - A-R-R-A-N-G-E. To arrange means to put things in a particular order. It has double R.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to keep safe?
explanation: Protect is the correct spelling - P-R-O-T-E-C-T. To protect means to keep someone or something safe from harm.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to bring to someone?
explanation: Deliver is the correct spelling - D-E-L-I-V-E-R. To deliver means to bring goods or a message to a specific place.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to work out numbers?
explanation: Calculate is the correct spelling - C-A-L-C-U-L-A-T-E. To calculate means to work out a number or amount using mathematics.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to hold in memory?
explanation: Remember is the correct spelling - R-E-M-E-M-B-E-R. To remember means to have something come back to mind from the past.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to look into something?
explanation: Investigate is the correct spelling - I-N-V-E-S-T-I-G-A-T-E. To investigate means to examine carefully and systematically.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to make something?
explanation: Manufacture is the correct spelling - M-A-N-U-F-A-C-T-U-R-E. To manufacture means to make goods, usually on a large scale in a factory.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to value highly?
explanation: Appreciate is the correct spelling - A-P-P-R-E-C-I-A-T-E. To appreciate means to recognise the value or quality of something. It has double P.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to mark a special occasion?
explanation: Celebrate is the correct spelling - C-E-L-E-B-R-A-T-E. To celebrate means to acknowledge a special occasion with festivities.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to pass on information?
explanation: Communicate is the correct spelling - C-O-M-M-U-N-I-C-A-T-E. To communicate means to share information with others. It has double M.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to get better?
explanation: Improve is the correct spelling - I-M-P-R-O-V-E. To improve means to make something better than it was before.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to give to a cause?
explanation: Donate is the correct spelling - D-O-N-A-T-E. To donate means to give something, usually to a charity or good cause.

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word: 'The teacher asked the students to _____ their work before handing it in.'
explanation: Examine is the correct spelling - E-X-A-M-I-N-E. To examine means to inspect something carefully.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to make bigger?
explanation: Expand is the correct spelling - E-X-P-A-N-D. To expand means to increase in size, scope, or importance.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to buy something?
explanation: Purchase is the correct spelling - P-U-R-C-H-A-S-E. To purchase means to buy something.

questionText: One of these verbs is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Apreciate is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is appreciate - A-P-P-R-E-C-I-A-T-E. Investigate, manufacture, and celebrate are all correct.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to achieve a goal?
explanation: Accomplish is the correct spelling - A-C-C-O-M-P-L-I-S-H. To accomplish means to achieve something successfully. It has double C.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to show how to do something?
explanation: Demonstrate is the correct spelling - D-E-M-O-N-S-T-R-A-T-E. To demonstrate means to show clearly how something works.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to keep trying despite difficulty?
explanation: Persevere is the correct spelling - P-E-R-S-E-V-E-R-E. To persevere means to continue despite difficulty or delay.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to work together?
explanation: Collaborate is the correct spelling - C-O-L-L-A-B-O-R-A-T-E. To collaborate means to work jointly with others. It has double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to think deeply?
explanation: Contemplate is the correct spelling - C-O-N-T-E-M-P-L-A-T-E. To contemplate means to think deeply and carefully about something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to make something bigger?
explanation: Exaggerate is the correct spelling - E-X-A-G-G-E-R-A-T-E. To exaggerate means to represent something as greater than it really is. It has double G.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to briefly describe?
explanation: Summarize is the correct spelling - S-U-M-M-A-R-I-Z-E. To summarize means to give a brief account of the main points. It has double M.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to sort into groups?
explanation: Categorize is the correct spelling - C-A-T-E-G-O-R-I-Z-E. To categorize means to place into a particular group or category.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to test a theory?
explanation: Hypothesize is the correct spelling - H-Y-P-O-T-H-E-S-I-Z-E. To hypothesize means to form a hypothesis or educated guess to be tested.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to take part in?
explanation: Participate is the correct spelling - P-A-R-T-I-C-I-P-A-T-E. To participate means to take part in an activity or event.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to describe by telling apart?
explanation: Differentiate is the correct spelling - D-I-F-F-E-R-E-N-T-I-A-T-E. To differentiate means to recognize or explain differences between things. It has double F.

questionText: One of these verbs is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Persevear is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is persevere - P-E-R-S-E-V-E-R-E. Accomplish, demonstrate, and collaborate are all correct.

questionText: One of these words is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Exagerate is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is exaggerate - E-X-A-G-G-E-R-A-T-E. Contemplate, summarize, and hypothesize are all correct.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to understand fully?
explanation: Comprehend is the correct spelling - C-O-M-P-R-E-H-E-N-D. To comprehend means to understand something fully.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to officially open?
explanation: Inaugurate is the correct spelling - I-N-A-U-G-U-R-A-T-E. To inaugurate means to formally admit someone to office or to open something officially.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to examine in detail?
explanation: Scrutinize is the correct spelling - S-C-R-U-T-I-N-I-Z-E. To scrutinize means to examine or inspect closely.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to spread through?
explanation: Permeate is the correct spelling - P-E-R-M-E-A-T-E. To permeate means to spread through or into every part of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to settle in a new country?
explanation: Emigrate is the correct spelling - E-M-I-G-R-A-T-E. To emigrate means to leave one's own country to live in another.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to make worse?
explanation: Deteriorate is the correct spelling - D-E-T-E-R-I-O-R-A-T-E. To deteriorate means to become progressively worse.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to give a new name?
explanation: Designate is the correct spelling - D-E-S-I-G-N-A-T-E. To designate means to officially give a title or status to.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to provide an example?
explanation: Illustrate is the correct spelling - I-L-L-U-S-T-R-A-T-E. To illustrate means to explain or make clear with examples. It has double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to speak up for?
explanation: Advocate is the correct spelling - A-D-V-O-C-A-T-E. To advocate means to publicly support or recommend a cause.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to obtain through effort?
explanation: Achieve is the correct spelling - A-C-H-I-E-V-E. To achieve means to successfully reach a goal through effort and skill.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to try to do?
explanation: Attempt is the correct spelling - A-T-T-E-M-P-T. To attempt means to make an effort to do something. It has double T.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to make use of?
explanation: Utilize is the correct spelling - U-T-I-L-I-Z-E. To utilize means to make practical or effective use of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to combine different things?
explanation: Integrate is the correct spelling - I-N-T-E-G-R-A-T-E. To integrate means to combine different elements so they work together.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to recover to good health?
explanation: Rehabilitate is the correct spelling - R-E-H-A-B-I-L-I-T-A-T-E. To rehabilitate means to restore someone to good health or normal life.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to make better by fixing?
explanation: Renovate is the correct spelling - R-E-N-O-V-A-T-E. To renovate means to restore or repair something to a good condition.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of an action word meaning to put into effect?
explanation: Implement is the correct spelling - I-M-P-L-E-M-E-N-T. To implement means to put a plan or decision into effect.
